mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market deterioration indicated by unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals reduced corporate earnings growth potential, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market contraction that signals imminent economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0 and UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST above 550,000 units), consumer spending and business investment are supported, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 550, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) indicates severe economic downturn with accommodative policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: dual-stress regime (low policy rate, high unemployment)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
